verdict.rationale: Klaviyo publishes an endpoint-by-endpoint API reference (e.g., create_campaign, create_event). Runnable exploration is documented through a Postman collection of pre-built requests and an importable spec, and test accounts can be seeded with sample data. However, the evidence never shows the reference itself being interactive (no in-page 'try it' console), so running examples depends on an external tool. Missing for 10: evidence of in-browser interactive/runnable examples within the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration of the exploration experience.
